delivery.question: How long does a blog platform take?
delivery.answer: A simple corporate blog takes 2-3 weeks, comprehensive news portals take 4-8 weeks.

pricing.question: How does it compare to WordPress?
pricing.answer: Our Next.js-based platforms are much faster, more secure and better for SEO than WordPress. Customization is unlimited.

revisions.question: Can I add content myself?
revisions.answer: Yes. We deliver a management panel that requires no technical knowledge. Add and edit posts whenever you want.

maintenance.question: Can you migrate my existing blog content?
maintenance.answer: Yes. We can migrate your existing WordPress or Medium content to the new platform while preserving SEO value.

migration.question: Do you set up a subscriber and newsletter system?

mobile.question: Can ad placements be added?
